source.name: Community Berger 30 Caliber 185 Grain Classic Hunter

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Hondo64d; Posted: Feb 2, 2018; 185gr Berger Classic Hunter. 24 in Criterion Light Varmint, 10 twist. The Feb 2 group was 4 of 5 into .285 in at 100 yards, lightly kissing the lands, and he later said that seating was .010 into the lands. A seating test liked .030 off. On Feb 9, 2018 he trued the velocity to 2662 fps with Ballistic AE, matched from 100 to 600 yards, and he had not chronographed it. On Apr 25, 2018 he wrote the same charge at magazine length, about .030 off, 5 shots in the .3s at 2662 fps. Base to ogive 2.190 is not COAL. A later Rokslide post said 2640 fps and did not repeat the charge.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Alaska Bush Man; Posted: Sep 30, 2019; Berger 185gr Classic. Bergara HMR 300 Win Mag. COAL @ 3.550. He said to seat the bullet out a little if the magazine allows.
